_note: Fully synthetic re-identification-risk eval fixture (HARDER variant). No real people. Candidates are deliberately CLUSTERED: cities, occupations, age brackets, sensitive attributes and hobbies OVERLAP, so no single quasi-identifier is unique. Identity must come from the COMBINATION. Each candidate summary lists ONLY quasi-identifiers (age + city/district + occupation + employer-type + a sensitive attribute + a hobby) and NO explicit PII. Each profile is prose weaving in explicit PII (Chinese name + mainland phone 13x/15x/18x; ~half also carry a checksum-valid MOD11-2 18-digit ID so argus fast mode actually redacts it) plus the SAME quasi-identifiers, so after explicit PII removal only the PARTIALLY-discriminating residuals remain.
